source_text: In die quo convictus fuerit, reddet. Dilatio confessionis auget vulnus. Hodie si vocem eius audieritis.
pass_a_gloss: On day on-which convicted he-will-have-been, he-will-repay. Delay of-confession increases wound. Today if voice his you-will-have-heard.
pass_b_english: [[On the day he is found guilty, he shall repay >> Bible:Leviticus 6:5]]. Delayed confession deepens the wound. [[Today, if you hear his voice >> Bible:Psalm 95:7]].
